messages:
alex: tf apply failed on cluster/gpu-prod when updating nodegroup-3; autoscaler spun up new GPU nodes but they stay Pending with CNI init crashloop

maria: ugh. paste events / pod logs?

alex: here — most relevant from kube-system: 
```bash
kubectl describe pod calico-node-7f9xz -n kube-system
Events:
  Warning  Failed     2s (x6 over 1m)  kubelet, ip-10-0-3-45  Failed to start container
  Normal   BackOff    1s (x5 over 55s) kubelet, ip-10-0-3-45  Back-off restarting failed container
Logs:
2026-03-17T12:07:12Z calico-node ERROR x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
```

sam: that error rings a bell — we bumped the calico chart last night (3.12 -> 3.13) in infra-gitops. chart includes a mutating webhook; looks like caBundle isn't getting populated after our kustomize patch. flux probably rendered webhook with empty caBundle.

jon: also saw terraform plan trying to change nodegroup tags/taints: desired taints includes "dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule" but module was expecting list. Plan showed replace (create + destroy) for nodegroup-3. if TF does replace while webhook broken, new nodes will never join.

ci-bot: Flux reconcile failed: helmrelease/gpu-cni error: rendered manifest contains a webhook with invalid caBundle (empty) -> rendering error.

maria: @oncall-sre can you take this? reverting the chart to previous version likely quickest.

oncall-sre: taking it. quick plan: revert HelmRelease chartVersion to 3.12, instruct flux to reconcile, block TF apply for nodegroup until we confirm. Doing: 
```bash
# in infra-gitops repo
git checkout -b revert/calico-pin-3.12
git revert --no-commit <last-chart-bump-commit>
git commit -m "revert: pin calico chart to 3.12 to avoid caBundle regression"
# push + open PR
```

alex: in parallel i'll add lifecycle ignore_changes for module.eks_node_group.taints so TF won't replace nodes in the current deploy. we need a follow-up to fix the kustomize patch that strips caBundle.

sam: i'll open PR to fix kustomize overlay (we accidentally removed webhook caBundle when converting patch to strategicMerge). will add e2e test: install calico and validate webhook caBundle non-empty.

jon: cost note — autoscaler created 4 extra p3s while nodes were Pending for ~2h, roughly $1800 extra on the run. we should add a guard: max-burst or cap scale-up in autoscaler config.

maria: PRs: https://git.company/redwood/infra-gitops/pull/214 (revert calico chart) and https://git.company/redwood/terraform/pull/789 (tf ignore_changes for taints). both open, CI running.

ci-bot: flux: sync for cluster/gpu-prod triggered by PR merge. status updates will follow.

oncall-sre: merge done, flux reconcile in progress. pods are restarting... calico-node now Running on new nodes. nodes Joined -> Ready.

alex: nice. killing the pending TF run; will re-run plan after infra-gitops fix merges so plan doesn't replace nodegroup.

sam: follow-up tickets: add helm chart preflight check in our gitops CI, add webhook-caBundle check to kustomize linter, and add autoscaler burst cap to cluster policy. I'll create them after lunch.

maria: incident resolved for now. logging a short postmortem and cost hit to finance. thanks all. :thumbsup:

oncall-sre: marking incident resolved and noting action items in #incidents. will ping infra oncall about any regressions overnight.

alex: thanks y'all. small checklist: 1) revert applied 2) tf ignore in place 3) kustomize fix and e2e test 4) autoscaler guard rails  — will follow up in PR comments.
